description: Defines an abstract class 'StringBase' for locale string objects in Drupal, including properties and methods for managing locale strings, storage, and locations.

classes.name: StringBase
classes.description: Abstract class for locale string objects, providing common properties and methods for source and translation strings.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new locale string object with optional initial values.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the version of the string.

methods.name: setVersion
methods.description: Sets the version of the string.

methods.name: getPlurals
methods.description: Returns an array of plural forms by splitting the string.

methods.name: setPlurals
methods.description: Sets the plural forms by joining an array into a string.

methods.name: getStorage
methods.description: Returns the storage object associated with the string.

methods.name: setStorage
methods.description: Assigns a storage object to the string.

methods.name: setValues
methods.description: Sets multiple property values from an array.

methods.name: getValues
methods.description: Retrieves specified property values as an array.

methods.name: getLocations
methods.description: Retrieves locations associated with the string, optionally checking only.

methods.name: addLocation
methods.description: Adds a location of a specific type and name.

methods.name: hasLocation
methods.description: Checks if a location of a specific type and name exists.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the string to its storage.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the string from its storage.
